subject.title: Feature Request: Memory Trust Tagging by Source

question: Should OpenClaw standardize native framework-assigned provenance and influence controls across memory plugins, or explicitly keep trust-governed memory as an external plugin/MCP responsibility?
rationale: Source inspection establishes the gap but cannot decide who authoritatively assigns trust, which fields become public contracts, which backend is recommended, or what upgrade behavior existing memory stores receive.

options.title: Standardize native contract
options.body: Define portable framework-assigned provenance and influence fields and require the recommended memory backend to persist and enforce them.

options.title: Keep plugin-scoped
options.body: Document an external plugin or MCP backend as the supported solution and open only narrow core API gaps needed to propagate trusted provenance.

recommendation.title: Standardize native contract
recommendation.body: Define portable framework-assigned provenance and influence fields and require the recommended memory backend to persist and enforce them.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the project lead, authored the prior issue-level design review, and is connected to the current memory scope and contract surfaces.
